description: This file defines enums, function prototypes, and macros related to branch management in a version control system, likely Git. It includes functionalities for tracking configuration, creating branches (including recursively), validating branch names, and managing branch state.

methods.name: dwim_and_setup_tracking
methods.description: Sets up tracking configuration for a new branch based on the specified tracking mode.

methods.name: create_branch
methods.description: Creates a new branch in the repository with specified parameters such as start point, force overwrite, reflog, track, and dry run options.

methods.name: create_branches_recursively
methods.description: Creates a new branch along with its submodules recursively, setting tracking information appropriately.

methods.name: branch_checked_out
methods.description: Returns the path to the worktree where a branch is currently checked out, if any.

methods.name: validate_branchname
methods.description: Validates whether a given name can be a branch name, and constructs the full ref name.

methods.name: validate_new_branchname
methods.description: Validates that a new branch name can be used, optionally allowing overwriting existing branches.

methods.name: remove_merge_branch_state
methods.description: Removes merge state information from the current branch.

methods.name: remove_branch_state
methods.description: Removes working state information from the current branch.

methods.name: install_branch_config
methods.description: Sets the local branch configuration to track a remote branch.

methods.name: read_branch_desc
methods.description: Reads the description of a branch into a buffer.

methods.name: die_if_checked_out
methods.description: Exits with error if the specified branch is currently checked out.
